executive_summary.verdict: The application is fundamentally sound — correct Vulkan initialization order, proper synchronization structure, correct vertex/pipeline configuration, and accurate geometry. However, it has 2 bugs that produce visible incorrect behavior, 1 bug that causes a deadlock under specific conditions, and widespread missing error checking that would cause silent crashes on allocation failures.
top_5_issues: SYNC-001: Fence deadlock when vkAcquireNextImageKHR returns VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR
SHADER-001: Specular highlights wrong — viewDir assumes camera at origin, but camera orbits at distance 6+
INIT-001: Exception during initVulkan() leaks all partially-created Vulkan resources
SWAP-001: Swapchain always created with hardcoded 1280x720 instead of actual framebuffer size
MEMORY-001: 10+ Vulkan/VMA calls have unchecked return values — silent failures cause crashes

high.title: Fence deadlock on VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR early return in drawFrame
high.description: When vkAcquireNextImageKHR returns VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR, drawFrame() returns early after vkWaitForFences consumed the fence (line 502) but before vkQueueSubmit can re-signal it (line 536). The next frame's vkWaitForFences blocks forever on an unsignaled fence — permanent deadlock.
high.fix: Move vkResetFences to just before vkQueueSubmit (after the acquire check). Pattern: wait fence → acquire → [early return OK, fence still signaled] → reset fence → submit.
high.impact: Application hangs on window resize or any event triggering swapchain recreation.

high.title: Incorrect specular highlight — viewDir assumes camera at world origin
high.description: Fragment shader computes viewDir = normalize(-fragWorldPos), which is only correct when camera is at (0,0,0). The orbit camera is at distance 6+ from origin. Camera position is never passed to the shader — no field in UBO or push constants for it.
high.fix: Add vec4 viewPos to UBO. Set to camera world position in updateUniformBuffer(). In frag shader: viewDir = normalize(viewPos.xyz - fragWorldPos).
high.impact: Specular highlights appear in wrong positions. Error worsens as camera moves away from origin.

high.title: Exception during initVulkan() leaks all partially-created Vulkan resources
high.description: run() calls initVulkan() then mainLoop() then cleanup(). If any step in initVulkan() throws, cleanup() is never called. All resources created before the failure are leaked. cleanup() is also not safe for partial initialization — it accesses vectors that may be empty.
high.fix: Wrap initVulkan() in try-catch that calls cleanup(). Make cleanup() safe for partial init (check VK_NULL_HANDLE before destroying). Or use RAII.
high.impact: Resource leak on init failure. Crash if cleanup() called with partial state.

high.title: 10+ Vulkan/VMA calls have unchecked return values
high.description: vmaCreateImage (L252), vkCreateImageView (L266), vmaCreateBuffer (L703), vmaMapMemory (L428,L715), vkQueueSubmit (L748), vkWaitForFences (L502), vkBeginCommandBuffer (L579), vkEndCommandBuffer (L657) all have unchecked VkResult returns. Silent failures cause crashes with no diagnostic.
high.fix: Check VkResult on all calls. Throw std::runtime_error with descriptive message on failure.
high.impact: Any allocation failure (out of GPU memory) causes undefined behavior or crash with no useful error message.

high.title: glfwInit() and glfwCreateWindow() return values not checked
high.description: glfwInit() returns GLFW_FALSE on failure (e.g., headless Linux) — not checked. glfwCreateWindow() returns nullptr on failure — not checked. Subsequent GLFW/Vulkan calls crash.
high.impact: Crash with no error message on systems where GLFW or window creation fails.

high.title: Uniform buffer memory mapped but never unmapped before destruction
high.description: vmaMapMemory called in createUniformBuffers (L428) but vmaUnmapMemory never called before vmaDestroyBuffer in cleanup (L107-109). Technically undefined behavior per Vulkan spec.
high.fix: Call vmaUnmapMemory before vmaDestroyBuffer for each uniform buffer. Or use VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_MAPPED_BIT.
high.impact: May cause issues with debug layers or future VMA versions. VMA currently handles this gracefully.

medium.title: Swapchain always created with hardcoded 1280x720 instead of actual framebuffer size
medium.fix: Query glfwGetFramebufferSize() and pass actual dimensions to set_desired_extent().

medium.title: Old swapchain not passed for resource reuse during recreation
medium.fix: Save old handle, pass to set_old_swapchain(), destroy old after new is created.

medium.title: Render pass and pipeline not recreated if swapchain format changes
medium.fix: Recreate render pass/pipeline on format change, or assert format unchanged.

medium.title: Depth format VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT hardcoded without device support query
medium.fix: Query vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties for D32/D32S8/D24S8 and select first supported.

medium.title: Per-vertex inverse(model) in vertex shader — expensive and unnecessary
medium.fix: Replace with mat3(push.model) * inNormal (no scaling used). Or precompute normal matrix on CPU.

medium.title: Division by zero in aspect ratio if swapchain height is 0
Deprecated VMA_MEMORY_USAGE enums used instead of VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO
medium.fix: Use VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO with appropriate host access flags.

medium.title: Missing pipeline barrier after staging buffer transfer
medium.fix: Add VkBufferMemoryBarrier with TRANSFER_WRITE → VERTEX_ATTRIBUTE_READ after vkCmdCopyBuffer.

medium.title: PhysicalDeviceSelector constructed with temporary vkb::Instance
medium.fix: Store vkb::Instance from createInstance() as class member and reuse.

medium.title: Present queue index not retrieved or validated
medium.fix: Store present queue family index. If different from graphics, set concurrent sharing mode.

medium.title: Pipeline creation error paths leak shader modules and pipeline layout
medium.fix: Destroy shader modules and pipeline layout before throwing on failure.

medium.title: No compiler warning flags configured (-Wall -Wextra)
medium.fix: Add target_compile_options with warning flags for MSVC/GCC/Clang.

medium.title: Shader path relative to CWD, not executable location
medium.fix: Resolve shader path relative to executable using std::filesystem.

medium.title: Validation layers always enabled including Release builds
drawFrame() called while window is minimized (zero-size framebuffer)
medium.fix: Check framebuffer size before drawFrame. Use glfwWaitEvents() when minimized.

low.title: Float time accumulation loses precision after ~4.66 hours
low.fix: Use fmod to wrap periodic values.

low.title: Degenerate zero-area triangles at sphere poles (128 per sphere)
Redundant time computation in recordCommandBuffer vs updateUniformBuffer
low.fix: Compute time once in drawFrame and pass to both.

low.title: Static startTime initialized at load time, not mainLoop start
low.fix: Make startTime a member, init in run().

low.title: UBO 'time' field set every frame but never used in shaders
UBO missing explicit std140 layout qualifier
Light position passed as varying instead of accessed from UBO in fragment
low.fix: Access UBO directly in fragment shader.

low.title: No color clamping — specular can push values above 1.0
PipelineConfig.extent is dead code (viewport/scissor are dynamic)
SPIR-V buffer alignment not guaranteed (char* → uint32_t* cast)
No pipeline cache used
Per-vertex color attribute wastes bandwidth (color is uniform per-sphere)
4 separate buffer uploads with vkQueueWaitIdle each
Central sphere mesh overdense at 32x64 (4096 triangles)
No per-swapchain-image fence tracking
Missing compile_shaders.sh for Linux/macOS
No default CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE for single-config generators
README build instructions Windows-only
PLAN.md version mismatches (vk-bootstrap, Vulkan version)
Camera yaw grows unbounded — precision loss over time

most_flagged_issues.issue: Old swapchain not passed during recreation
Uniform buffers not unmapped before destruction

unique_insights.insight: SYNC-VK-001: Fence deadlock — most impactful bug found. Only the sync specialist caught the full causal chain.
LIGHTING-VK-001: Incorrect viewDir — shader math expert traced through the actual camera position vs assumed origin.
Complete 31-resource inventory with creation/destruction mapping — systematic lifecycle verification.
GEOM-VK-003: Float time precision loss after 4.66 hours — long-running stability analysis.
BUILD-VK-006: Shader path relative to CWD — cross-platform deployment concern unique to build audit.

verified_correct: Vulkan initialization order: instance → surface → physical device → logical device → allocator → swapchain
Destruction order: reverse of creation, VMA allocations before allocator, device before instance
UBO std140 layout: C++ struct with _pad[3] matches GLSL layout exactly at 160 bytes
Descriptor pool: exactly MAX_FRAMES_IN_FLIGHT UBO descriptors and max sets
Push constants: 64 bytes (mat4), well under 128-byte minimum guarantee
Vertex attribute formats/offsets match shader input locations (0-2)
Render pass: CLEAR/STORE for color, CLEAR/DONT_CARE for depth — correct
Rasterization: CCW front face + back cull + Y-flip is correct Vulkan pattern
Depth test: enabled, write enabled, LESS compare — correct for opaque rendering
Sphere geometry: correct vertex count, normals, index generation, no off-by-one errors
Camera: spherical-to-Cartesian conversion, lookAt, perspective with Y-flip all correct
Model matrix composition: Rorbit × Translate × Rself — correct for orbiting body
Shader modules destroyed after pipeline creation
Swapchain cleanup properly destroys old image views, framebuffers, depth resources
